pictures.author: Sangwinc
pictures.observations: Filename says2024 but page/EXIF date is2023. Broad exterior shows low uneven battered broch masonry, roofless surrounding wall remnants, upright flagstones, grassy banks and visible earthworks; no intact tall prehistoric tower.

pictures.author: Ellievking1
pictures.observations: Roofless irregular courtyard with upright flagstone partitions and stone shelves, deep wall openings/entrance lintel, muted layered masonry, gravel and a covered opening. Panorama distorts exact plan proportions.

pictures.author: Ellievking1
pictures.observations: Wider low view corroborates stepped wall loss, exposed interior divisions, low village walls and grassy ground. The view does not measure the whole settlement layout.

pictures.author: J.S. Richardson
pictures.license: Public domain (expired Crown copyright, as declared by Commons)
pictures.observations: Ordinary Commons plan image resolves north-up east entrance, irregular surrounding house-wall arrangement and partial intramural gallery. Used only for broad simplified linework; no labels or pixels copied and no removed/dashed buildings reconstructed. Modern exposed wall heights and fine surviving inventory remain approximate.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific present-day Broch of Gurness ruins: mapped thick irregular annular masonry and open courtyard, east entrance passage/closed lintel, partly exposed intramural pocket, uneven truncated wall profile, upright stone partitions/shelves/low hearth and covered opening, plus simplified surrounding settlement and enclosure wall remnants. Four existing shared coursed-sandstone/raw-sandstone/gravel/painted-metal graphs. No reconstructed tall tower or roof, furnished prehistoric dwellings, literal inscription/sign atlas, visitor building, whole coastal terrain or invented complete ancient village.
